model.formula: same ECEF_to_ENU as G1; independent domain guard only
near_model_checks: PROJ cart+topocentric on all selected points
Geod inverse raw/current edges and stage lengths
independent AEQD direction and DP decisions for all registered grid thresholds and actual stage indices
model.sensitivity_difference_action: retain record and differences; mark conditional dependence; no coordinate/model selection by cleaning score

stage_rules.S: current-index strict dt>threshold OR dt<0 OR distance>threshold; right boundary point belongs only to right segment; immediately filter current segment min_points/min_length
stage_rules.D: teacher both circular neighbor direction differences strictly greater than threshold; mark once and remove simultaneously; endpoints and undefined/zero-displacement windows preserved
stage_rules.P: finite-segment DP, preserve endpoints, equality does not recurse, degenerate endpoint distance, zero tolerance keeps all
stage_rules.before_S: raw record boundaries only; no implicit time/distance segmentation
stage_rules.after_P: later D/S removals distinct from DP immediate output

common_reference.source: trusted immutable complete raw records transformed by frozen G2 model
common_reference.window_break: dt>30 or dt<0 or adjacent distance>400
common_reference.point_error: retained raw point 0; otherwise finite segment distance only to bracketing same-final-segment consecutive indices within same fixed raw window; no cross-window interpolation
common_reference.crossing_rule: any final same-segment edge a<b with original break index j satisfying a<j<=b

metrics.denominator: all input records including those removed by multiple stages

metrics.definition: per-record/per-stage input/output/removed counts, filter reasons and unique terminal ledger
metrics.denominator: all raw points, all records, all S-created segments

metrics.reference: complete immediate P input, same upstream for comparisons

metrics.definition: finite-segment distance for every full P input point to its original-index bracketing immediate P output edge; max/mean/q50/q90/q95/q99/exceedances
metrics.reference: complete P input for this actual order

metrics.definition: covered original point identity set and count divided by all raw points; retained point or bracketing final edge within fixed raw window
finite segment error per covered raw point; uncovered null; full observed mask retained
metrics.denominator: all raw points with valid/invalid counts reported

metrics.definition: candidate and reference max error restricted to the same frozen reference covered original-index set
metrics.reference: common raw plus reference covered identity set
metrics.denominator: reference covered point identities; set must be subset of candidate coverage

metrics.definition: final same-segment edges a<b spanning any fixed raw break j with a<j<=b; count edges and unique breaks separately
metrics.reference: raw strict dt>30 or dt<0 or distance>400
metrics.denominator: all fixed raw breaks and all candidate final edges

metrics.definition: which original break adjacent indices remain after each stage; distinguish omission/no output from crossing
sum of within-current-segment distances; delta and relative delta from stage input
speed/direction computable current edges and reasons for all others
legal raw proposals / all raw proposals before any fallback; missing/malformed/rejected included
metrics.denominator: all attempted proposal slots with response/failure categories

metrics.definition: valid raw proposals actually executed / all raw proposals; cache separately flagged
predicted metric sign vs actual paired delta bound before execution; evaluate only declared comparable metric with nonnearzero delta
metrics.denominator: declared and evaluable nonnearzero predictions; undeclared/unavailable/nearzero separately

metrics.definition: retrieved/eligible/delivered/cited/action-consistent counts and IDs, with same-pair proposal differences
metrics.denominator: memory episodes/cards with separate eligible/cited denominators

metrics.definition: separate actual governance dispatches, experiment dispatches, tools, candidate evaluations, cache/replay reads, visible wall/tokens/request IDs
metrics.denominator: all attempted operations including failed attempts

selection.predeclared_order: A registers before each development round; shortlist order fixed before selection
SD_guards: baseline nonempty record/window coverage not lost
SD_primary: strict increase in common covered raw point count
strict reduction in max common raw error evaluated on the same baseline-covered set
P_guards: each nonempty record immediate P max error <= 5 + fixed numeric epsilon
selection.P_primary: fewer immediate P output points at exactly identical complete P input, actual error <=5
selection.null: cannot establish geometric improvement; report coverage gain separately
selection.incomparable: retain already protected incumbent; preserve tradeoffs

release_gate.engineering_error: freeze affected runs; repair implementation; new code/run and disclose exposure

mode.memory_access: FROZEN_READONLY; not used by deterministic record processing

full_audit.coordinate: PROJ cart+topocentric for all points; raw adjacent Geod distances; actual stage thresholds and DP intervals under same-ellipsoid AEQD; no all-pairs requirement

category_selection.fallback: stable random rank; all receipts additionally checked
category_selection.failure: stable random rank; all receipts additionally checked
category_selection.near_S_threshold: minimum absolute margin of actual adjacent distance to400 or segment length to active min_length, exact equality included; stable rank tie
category_selection.near_D_threshold: minimum absolute margin of calculable actual direction differences to active threshold; stable rank tie
category_selection.near_P_threshold: minimum absolute margin of actual interval residuals to5; stable rank tie
category_selection.extreme_span: descending original ENU bbox diagonal; stable rank tie
category_selection.new_coverage: descending added common raw point count; stable rank tie
category_selection.worst_common_error: descending final common max over its covered points; null excluded with reason; stable rank tie

full_audit.uncertainty: descriptive paired records and strata; no IID-person inference or true-noise accuracy

resources.record_tools: serial deterministic; preflight timings on development; bounded finite candidates
resources.governance: native Codex A/B/C contexts, separate from tested modes
resources.reserve: final confirmation + two full production strategies + full Notebook/isolated ZIP recomputation + report/C review

exploration_constraints.parameter_domain: registered G2 grids only; no continuous or six-factor exhaustive search
exploration_constraints.unknown_group_fallback: R0 or previously registered incumbent; exact choice fixed in strategy
exploration_constraints.runtime_features: verified original diagnostics only, available at inference time
